title: Saying no, and what instead
sub: Film 3 of Working with people, in Leading data people: when more is asked than a team can do well. Ask what the date is for, put the trade-off where everyone can see it, offer what you can do well, and when, let the people who decide choose, and keep your word.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: the team's rooms in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans (the dates offered and agreed), orange is data (the forecast and the rooms' data), green is something done or kept, and amber a cost or a risk (the weeks that don't fit).
